# Shadow Review — PR #260 (issue #259: humanize table column headers and chart axis titles)

## Verdict: APPROVE

Blinded, independent shadow re-review of the full diff (5 files, +314/-27): `src/sqllens/tools/_format.py`, `src/sqllens/ui/query_results.html`, and three test files. Full Phase 3 roster fanned out (4 always-on + pr-test-analyzer; type-design-analyzer gated out, has_new_types=false; completeness-critic skipped, detect_all_audit=false). No CI evidence handed in — test evidence settled by reading source (suite not run per run policy). No suite/lint pass observed in-env, so test evidence is reported as not independently established here; the diff's own tests were verified by reading them, not executing them.

## Phase 1/2 checklist verification
13 verifiable claims enumerated and all verified PASS against HEAD source:
- _humanize_label transform (split/capitalize/acronym-upper), acronym set superset of AC minimum (+usd), snake_case regex rejects non-conforming names -> verbatim passthrough, idempotence.
- Additive column_labels parallel to raw columns; column_types + typed sort key off raw names (AC #6).
- Binary-search row-trim now measures each candidate with the row_count/truncated it will carry, final values set from lo; row_count+truncated==total invariant preserved.
- _default_axis_label fills axis label from humanized field only when label empty; LLM-set label preserved; non-dict/missing-field returned unchanged (AC #3,#4). Chart series carried through untouched (AC #7).
- _display_labels length-guarded fallback shared by markdown table + one-row surfaces; _render_dataframe parity; widget header uses label with raw fallback (AC #1,#2).
- Tests pin ACs #2,#3,#4,#6,#7,#8.

## Phase 3 findings (all Suggestion severity; none blocking)
1. comment-analyzer (style, low-confidence): _ACRONYMS provenance comment (_format.py:17-21) is largely derivation/worked-example rather than naming a specific wrong change; load-bearing status arguably undecidable (carve-out).
2. pr-test-analyzer (test_gap): _default_axis_label defensive branches (non-dict axis; missing/non-string field) untested (_format.py:1057-1073).
3. pr-test-analyzer (test_gap): _display_labels length-mismatch fallback branch untested (_format.py:1308-1320).
4. pr-test-analyzer (test_gap): incidental binary-search size-budget change (_format.py:989-1007) has no near-ceiling test.
5. final-pass (other): CSV export header stays raw snake_case while visible widget header is humanized (query_results.html:282-286) — intentional, outside ACs; UX judgment call, not a defect.

## Assessment
Clean, additive, display-only change. All 8 acceptance criteria trace to shipped code. Raw payload identity keys intact; labels degrade gracefully to raw names when absent/mismatched. No Critical or Important findings from any of the 5 reviewers. Dirty-tree backstop: tree clean before dispatch (snapshot OID e69de29 = empty), no agent modified the tree. APPROVE.
